caption:
Tonga beat Lebanon 36-0 at the Rugby League World Cup in Sydney. 🏉

Tonga scored seven tries, three before half-time and four after, with Sione Katoa and Jojo Fifita crossing twice each.

Lebanon play France next, on Sunday 1 November at CommBank Stadium. Who's backing the Cedars? 🇱🇧

Source: Zero Tackle, Rugby League Hub
